title: The 0DTE strategy with zero risk? Boomer Dan’s “Levitation trades” explained
summary: Dan Westbrook ('Boomer Dan' — SAME trader as the Burrito Butterfly interview) pitches '0DTE levitation trades' on SPX: open an ATM 5-wide credit spread plus a ~$1 hedge, and once the directional leg gains, buy the opposite spread to lift the whole position above the zero line ('levitate') into a guaranteed-profit butterfly, then stack a 'wall of butterflies.' 'Zero-risk / minus-zero' is conditional on first winning the entry's directional bet (he admits no firm direction edge); if wrong or the market just sags, you take a loss. No separable track record (netted into a larger portfolio). Write-up: strategies/levitation_trades.md (conviction 1.5/5).
